استخففن (form X)
# اِسْتَخْفَفْنَ (istaḵfafna) /is.tax.faf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخَفَّ (istaḵaffa)
# اُسْتُخْفِفْنَ (ustuḵfifna) /us.tux.fif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَخَفَّ (istaḵaffa)
# اِسْتَخْفِفْنَ (istaḵfifna) /is.tax.fif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخَفَّ (istaḵaffa)
